name: PaperdollComponentServerFacet_ServerEquipItem
summary: The client's equip request: two u64 BE head fields, three u32 BE request parameters, a 16-byte item id, then a bool byte. 45-byte body, C2S. Six live 45-byte records match the static writer/reader layout field for field.
purpose: The paperdoll/equip request bus composes this after the can-equip gate passes; the two head u64 are the shared character identity pair, the three u32 are the caller's equip parameters, the 16 bytes are the item instance id, and the bool is the flag passed on the stack. The server changes the paperdoll replicated state.

created_when: an inventory weapon cell is double-clicked, running the PaperdollComponentServerFacet equip request bus
lifecycle.if_absent: no equip request reaches the server and the item stays unequipped

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint b7 3c, i.e. type_dec 3895. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.

fields.name: field_a
fields.note: First of the shared 16-byte head (FUN_1414dbca0). Measured 0x307df08e15b85dab in all six live records. meanings.md 'The second field layout: 0xf37'.

fields.name: local_actor_id_word0
fields.note: Second u64 of the shared message head, and the first 8 bytes of the client's own actor id - identity, not request data. Writer FUN_1414dbca0 copies the message object's +0x10 through a stack local and writes it big-endian (htonl64 FUN_1461668a0) through the stream raw-write slot +0x40. The send builder fills +0x10 from FUN_1416be9f0, which dereferences the weak handle at the GDE's +0x60 (FUN_14165c230) and reads [session+0x88]. Measured 0xbf85314bbc4a951a in all 14 committed bodies of the six head-prefixed messages across five sessions; in the same records its little-endian bytes 1a954abc4b3185bf are the first 8 of the record's 16-byte actor id, the local player's actor id handed over by ClientAddEntryMsg (0xa4).

fields.name: field_c
fields.note: u32 BE validated as an int in [-1, 501] (FUN_142e6bae0). Measured 0x147, 0x14a, 0x142, 0x120 across the six live records. meanings.md 'The second field layout: 0xf37'.

fields.name: field_d
fields.note: u32 BE, validated by FUN_142d94d20. Measured 0x18/0x1b/0x19. meanings.md 'The second field layout: 0xf37'.

fields.name: field_e
fields.note: u32 BE, validated by FUN_142d94df0. Measured 0x1 on every live record. meanings.md 'The second field layout: 0xf37'.

fields.name: field_f
fields.note: The 16-byte item id, written and read verbatim with no byte swap (from FUN_145c495c0(itemDescriptor)). Carried as guid16 because the codec is exactly 16 raw bytes. meanings.md 'The second field layout: 0xf37'.

fields.name: field_g
fields.note: A u8 bool (0/1) passed on the stack. Measured 0x00. meanings.md 'The second field layout: 0xf37'.
